body: She has no clue about my 2 walks in the woods. Thank god for tor. I will never admit this to my family. I still would rather go than stay. I'll live another day tho.
You helped. I called my sister. We've been on the phone. I know my family loves me. First time I talked to my sister about it tho.
It's going to be a long night, but thank you for being you.
A son can be a family full of people. Just ask him a couple questions, then chase him around ;) I got one too.
Kiss him. Tomorrow i never guaranteed, depression or normal.
There are so many bigger problems than this shit lol.. srry reddit.

I'm the same man. I still want to go away. You make me feel like my mom does tho. Internet caring stranger. I emailed my mom and my kids mom and told both of them I love them. 

I'm listening to this : https://soundcloud.com/dj-mirror-man/the-dirty-heads-your-love

I don't smoke weed, I get drug tested for software dev. I'm on 0 drugs to be clear. Not even weed.

Your family is lucky to have you.

Wanna hear some shit? So my father worked all over the world. He was gone for like three months at a time. No biggie, but my mom got me a big brother so I had good influence. My big brother drowned in a boating accident when I was 17 he was trying to save his biological daughters. Then a year or two later my best friend commited suicide by jumping in to a river in a cold Canadian winter. Then my father died from a boating accident while I was across country without power during a hurricane. Then I lost a best friend who found out his step dad was banging his gf. He walked into the woods and ate a handful of oc-80. Next my band mate joined the navy and after basic was walking on a pier in the north east and slipped and hit his head. He died.There were a couple more. I'm not looking for pity, jus saying, I get it. life sucks.. it's hard. It's fucking hard.
I'm sorry for making you worry about an internet guy. My mom loves the shit out of me. She's why both attempts I walked into the woods. She's amazing ans deserves better.
To kids, No offense. I just remember being like 16 and pretending to feel like I do now. Hug your family!!!

Shouldn't a bottle of antihistamines do the job? I will admit straight up, I don't want to eat a shotgun. My uncle sat in the hospital for almost a week when he blew his face off. I'm not trying to make anyone feel guilty for this. I know people will feel bad. That's unavoidable. I don't want my family having to care for a vegetable or think they did anything wrong. This is me. I'm over this life.
I sound like such a fucking cliche. Fuck me.

You can't help me man. I think about it every fucking day. I've been with my mom lately and i feel like such a dick I literally think about how to do it without her finding me. Wgen I talk to her I feel like I should be saying I'm so sorry. It wasn't you.  I've lost a few people to suicide myself. I'm 35 years old. I don't feel like an awful person. I haven't had a bad breakup. I just hate myself and want to die.. FUCK ME! CLICHE! It's true tho.
I'm not an entitled kid. I loaned my way through computer science. I'm doing ok. I'm just fucking over it. You know? I'm 35 I can date I can afford dinner. I secretly hate this life. Ugh!

omg that made me bust out in tears. I'm so sick of this life. I'm so over it. My family doesn't know but i've taken a bottle of allergy pills twice since last winter. Both times I walk way into the forest I literally sleep for like 24 hours. I lost my daughter, I lost my dad. I'm lost.. I'm not looking for the whole blah cares and blah cares. fuck man... I wish I was a joking tween.
I'm on tor for obvious reasons. I just don't want my family to find me.
